t: Din maqom harauy lehitpallel veholek badderek
s: Din maqom harauy lehitpallel veholek badderek ubo k"h seipim: hammitpallel tzarik sheyyakin maqom rauy litpillato, vesheyyakin lah begadayv vegupo umachashabto. Maqom ketzad? Lo yaamod lo al gabbe mitta, velo al gabbe kisse, velo al gabbe sapsal, velo al gabbe maqom gaboah veyitpallel, ella bemaqom namuk, lepi sheen gabhut lipne hammaqom, shenneemar: "mimmaamaqqim qeratika Hashem". Veim haya zaqen o choleh sheqqasheh lo lered min hammitta — muttar laamod aleha im epshar lo laamod. Veken sheliach tzibbur shetztzarik lehashmia latztzibbur — muttar lo laamod al gabbe maqom gaboah, apillu al gabbe kisse vesapsal, veen bazeh mishshum gabhut, kevan shekkavvanato bazeh kede lehashmia latztzibbur. Veakshav nahagu shehammaqom shehashsheliach tzibbur omed alayv hu amoq mishshear bet hakkeneset, mishshum "mimmaamaqqim qeratika Hashem". Velaken niqra hashsheliach tzibbur bekol maqom "yored lipne hatteba":

Shiur maqom gaboah sheameru hu g' tepachim, sheppachot mikken en gobho nikkar. Haya gaboah g' veyesh bo d' ammot al d' ammot — hare hu kaaliyya umuttar lehitpallel bo. Veken im haya muqqap mechitztzot, ap al pi sheen bo d' ammot al d' ammot — muttar lehitpallel bo, sheen gobho nikkar kevan shechalaq reshut leatzmo:

Haummanim shealu laasot melaka lebaal habbayit berosh hazzayit o berosh hatteena vehiggia zeman tepilla — omedin sham umitpalelin, veen bazeh mishshum "lo yaamod adam al gabbe maqom gaboah veyitpallel", shekkevan shealu laasot sham melaktam — hare zeh kemo shealu laaliyya. Abal bishar ilanot tzerikim lered lematta ulehitpallel. Velamma nishtannu hazzayit vehatteena mishshear ilanot? Mippene sheyyesh lahem anapim harbeh yoter mishshear ilanot veyesh torach gadol baaliyyatam viridatam veyitbattelu mimmelaktam, velaken ameru sheyyitpallelu sham, abal shear ilanot sheen bahen bittul melaka kol kak — yeredu. Abal baal habbayit kevan sheeno meshubad lammelaka, shehu birshut atzmo — tzarik lered apillu merosh hazzayit vehatteena, lepi sheen dato meyushshebet alayv kesheomed berosh hailan, shemmityare shello yippol veeno yakol lekavven heteb, veim heqellu etzel poalim mishshum bittul melaka — lo heqellu etzel baal habbayit:

Tzarik liptoach petachim o challonot bebet hakkeneset keneged yerushalayim kede lehitpallel kenegdo, shenneemar: "vekavvin petichan leh beilliteh neged yerushelem", lepi sheggoremin lo lekavven libbo, shehu mistakkel kelappe shamayim velibbo nikna. Veap al pi shehammitpallel tzarik sheyyitten enayv lematta kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tz"h, mikkol maqom keshennitbattela kavvanato — yissa enayv lashshamayim leorer hakkavvana. Veken keshemmitpallel bebayit acher shello bebet hakkeneset — tzarik lehitpallel bebayit sheyyesh bo challonot. Vetob shebbebet hakkeneset yihyu y"b challonot. Veen tzarik shekkullam yihyu bammizrach, ella yoter tob shekkol hatztzedadim yihyu petuchim:

Lo yitpallel ella bebayit, velo bemaqom parutz kemo bassadeh, ella im ken hu badderek, mippene shekkeshehu bimqom tzeniut — chala alayv emat melek velibbo nishbar. Umikkol maqom, lo yikkanes lechurba kede lehitpallel bimqom tzeniut, mippene hachashad sheyyachsheduhu sheyyesh lo zona meyuchedet sham, umippene hammappolet umippene hammazziqin. Veim hachurba omedet bassadeh — en lachosh bah lachashad, sheen zona metzuya bassadeh. Veim hi churba beria vachazaqa — en lachosh bah lemappolet. Veim shenayim niknasin bah — en lachosh lemazziqin, shelleechad nireh umazziq, velishnayim nireh veeno mazziq, velishlosha eno nireh kol iqqar, im lo bemaqom sheyyadua shergilin sham mazziqim, vaabuqa kishnayim, veyareach kishlosha. Lepikak, im hem shenayim — muttar likkanes bah, im hi beria vachazaqa veomedet bassadeh. Veim lav — mutab lehitpallel badderek millikkanes bah. Veim mityare shello yapsiquhu obere derakim — yitpallel tepilla qetzara shehi "habinenu", kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"y:

Hammitpallel y"ch achore bet hakkeneset veeno hopek panayv lebet hakkeneset — niqra rasha. Yesh meporshim sheachore bet hakkeneset hu hatztzad shehappetach patuach bo, dehaynu maarab, ukeshemmitpallel beoto tzad chutz lebet hakkeneset vehopek achorayv lebet hakkeneset — niqra rasha, mippene shennireh kekoper bemi shehatztzibbur mitpalelin lepanayv, shehem mitpalelim kelappe mizrach vehu mitpallel kelappe maarab venireh kishte rashuyyot. Abal im haya omed mibbachutz lekotel mizrachi upanayv kelappe hammizrach ap al pi sheachorayv lebet hakkeneset, kevan shemmitpallel lammizrach kemo shehatztzibbur mitpalelin — eno nireh kekoper veeno niqra rasha. Veyesh meporshim sheachore bet hakkeneset hu achore kotel mizrachi, veim omed umitpallel sham upanayv kelappe hammizrach — niqra rasha, hoil vaachorayv lebet hakkeneset. Abal keshemmachazir panayv lebet hakkeneset ap al pi shemmitpallel kelappe maarab vehatztzibbur kelappe mizrach — en bekak kelum, kevan sheppene kol haqqahal kelappe kotel mizrachi upanayv gam ken kelappe oto kotel. Verauy lachosh ledibre shenehem shello lehitpallel mibbachutz lekotel mizrachi, ben shehopek panayv lebet hakkeneset, ben shehopek panayv lammizrach vaachorayv lebet hakkeneset, veshello lehitpallel mibbachutz lekotel maarabi upanayv kelappe maarab vaachorayv lebet hakkeneset (ki zeh niqra rasha ledibre hakkol). Abal im panayv lebet hakkeneset, kevan shemmitpallel kelappe mizrach kemo shehatztzibbur mitpalelin ap al pi sheomed mibbachutz — en bekak kelum ledibre hakkol. Ella shellekattechilla mitzva min hammubchar lehitpallel bebet hakkeneset im hatztzibbur, kemo sheyyitbaer:

Uledibre hakkol im omed mibbachutz letzad tzapon o darom vaachorayv lebet hakkeneset — niqra gam ken rasha, mippene sheeno mitpallel laruach shehatztzibbur mitpalelin, vegam achorayv lebet hakkeneset. Veim hopek panayv lebet hakkeneset — ledibre hakkol eno niqra rasha. Ap al pi sheeno mitpallel leruach mizrach kemo shehatztzibbur mitpalelin — en lachosh, kevan sheeno mitpallel lemaarab hepek mimmah shemitpalelin hatztzibbur, vegam panayv hu lebet hakkeneset (abal yoter tob sheyyitpallel lemizrach kemo hatztzibbur, veap al pi sheen panayv lebet hakkeneset — en bekak kelum, kevan sheen achorayv lebet hakkeneset):

Vekol zeh keshebbet hakkeneset omed kemigdal bemaqom sheppanuy kol sebibayv, vehammitpallel omed etzel echad mikketalayv bachutz bachatzar bet hakkeneset, shekkeshehu hopek achorayv lebet hakkeneset — hapikato nikkeret umezalzel bah, vahare (hu) meotam shenneemar bahem "achorehem el hekal Hashem". Abal im hu mitpallel bebayit o baazara hassemukim lebet hakkeneset upanayv keneged eretz yisrael karauy vaachorayv lekotel haazara shehu kotel mizrachi shel bet hakkeneset — muttar, sheeno nikkar shemmachazir achorayv lebet hakkeneset, kevan shehu birshut bipne atzmo:

Asur laabor chutz lebet hakkeneset batztzad shehappetach patuach beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpalelin, mippene shenireh keporeq ol umebazzeh bet hakkeneset, kevan sheober etzel happetach veeno niknas. Veim haya labush tepillin — muttar, mippene shennireh lakkol sheeno mipporeqe ol. Veim haya nose massa — muttar, shemmassao mokachat alayv shezzeh shello niknas hu mippene hammasseoy velo mishshum periqat ol. Veken im haya rokeb al gabbe behema — muttar, lepi shennireh lakkol shemmippene shehu tarud bishmirat behemto eno niknas, veen bazeh bizzuy lebet hakkeneset. Veken im yesh bet hakkeneset acher bair, o shellebet hakkeneset zeh yesh petach acher — muttar, sheen kan bizzuy, sheharoeh yomar sheyyikkanes lebet hakkeneset acher o lebet hakkeneset zeh bepetach acher, ap im qetzat lo yomru kak — en bekak kelum, sheen taam haissur mishshum chashad ella mishshum bizzuy bet hakkeneset, vekevan sheeno nikkar venireh lekol roehu ober kan sheeno rotzeh likkanes kelal lebet hakkeneset — en kan bizzuy lebet hakkeneset bipnehem, ki shemma yikkanes lebet hakkeneset acher o bepetach acher:

Leolam yishtaddel adam lehitpallel bebet hakkeneset im hatztzibbur, veap al pi sheyyakol lehitpallel bebeto baasara, mikkol maqom "berab am hadrat melek", vegam en tepillato shel adam nishmaat ella bebet hakkeneset, shenneemar: "lishmoa el harinna veel hattepilla", bimqom rinna sham (tehe tepilla), dehaynu bebet hakkeneset sheshsham omerim hatztzibbur shirot vetishbachot binimot qol areb — sham tehe hattepilla nishmaat. Veim hu anus sheen yakol labo lebet hakkeneset, kegon shettash kocho ap al pi sheeno choleh, im i epshar lo leesop asara elayv — yesh lo lekavven lehitpallel beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpalelin bebet hakkeneset, shehi et ratzon, veen tepillato nidchet, ap al pi sheenah mitqabbelet beratzon kemo bebet hakkeneset im hatztzibbur. Veim mitpallel musap beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpalelin shacharit, o lehepek — eno niqra beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpalelin. Vehu haddin bene adam haddarim beyishshubim veen lahem minyan — yesh lahem lehitpallel shacharit umincha beshaa sheqqehillot yisrael mitpalelin. Abal arbit tzerikim lehamtin ad tzet hakkokabim, shello heqellu lehitpallel mibbeod yom ella mishshum torach hatztzibbur, shei epshar lachazor uleospam litpillat arbit ballayla im yipparedu ish meal achiv achar tepillat hammincha, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman rl"h. Abal hammitpalelin beyachid tzerikim lehitpallel bizmannah. Veap tepillat shacharit bimot haqqayitz shehatztzibbur meacharin otah, ap al pi sheen oberin zeman qeriat shema utepilla, mikkol maqom kevan shehammitpallel beyachid asur apillu lilmod ad sheyyitpallel kemo shennitbaer sy' p"t — en lo lehamtin kelal ad shaa shehatztzibbur mitpalelin bebet hakkeneset, ella yitpallel miyyad benetz hachamma. Umi shehu bair veneenas velo hitpallel im hatztzibbur vehu mitpallel beyachid leachar shekkebar gameru kol hatztzibbur tepillatam bebet hakkeneset — ap al pi ken yesh lo lehitpallel bebet hakkeneset, mippene shehu maqom qabua umeyuchad litpillat tzibbur utepillato shel adam nishmaat sham kemo shennitbaer leel, vegam mippene shehaqqadosh baruk hu matzuy bebet hakkeneset, shenneemar: "elohim nitztzab baadat el", kelomar bebet moed shello shennoadim sham lepanayv:

Ap al pi shemmi shettash kocho veeno yakol labo lebet hakkeneset yesh lo lekavven ulehitpallel beshaa shehatztzibbur mitpallelim, mikkol maqom zeh eno ella lemitzva min hammubchar, lepi shehu et ratzon. Abal im ba lehaqdim tepillato litpillat hatztzibbur — en bazeh issur min haddin. Lepikak im challash libbo veqasheh alayv lehamtin milleekol ad achar gemar tepillat hatztzibbur — muttar lehaqdim tepillato bebeto kede leekol miyyad. Abal mi shebba lebet hakkeneset — asur lo lehaqdim tepillato litpillat hatztzibbur, ben bebet hakkeneset ben sherotzeh latzet chutz lebet hakkeneset, ella yamtin kede lehitpallel im hatztzibbur, shettepillat harabbim hi retzuya yoter lipne hammaqom, ella im ken roeh shezzeman hattepilla ober veen hatztzibbur mitpalelim, lepi shemmaarikim bepiyyutim o lesibba acheret — mitpallel hu bipne atzmo kede lehitpallel beonatah. Abal im en zeman tepilla ober veap al pi shehem maarikim bepiyyutim — lo yaqdim tepillato litpillat hatztzibbur bishbil kak, ella yinhog kemo shennitbaer siman s"ch. Veim hu choleh o anus ones acher, shei epshar lo lehamtin al hatztzibbur — yakol lehaqdim tepillato apillu bebet hakkeneset. Abal im eno choleh ella shechallash libbo vetzarik leekol — eno rashshay lehaqdim ella keshehu bebeto (shello ba kelal lebet hakkeneset. Abal im ba — asur apillu rotzeh latzet chutz lebet hakkeneset ulehitpallel qodem hatztzibbur):

Mi sheyyesh lo bet hakkeneset beiro veeno niknas bo lehitpallel — niqra "shaken ra" vegorem galut lo ulebanayv, shenneemar: "koh amar Hashem al kol shekenay haraim hannogeim bannachala asher hinchalti et ammi vego' hineni notesham meal admatam vego'". Vekol hammashkim umaarib lebet hakkeneset — zokeh laarikut yamim, shenneemar: "ashre adam shomea li lishqod al daltotay vego'", uketib acharayv: "ki motzei matza chayyim vego'". Veim yesh shene bet hakkeneset beiro — tob lelek leharechoqa, ki sekar pesiot yesh:

Mitzva larutz lebet hakkeneset, veken lekol debar mitzva, shenneemar: "nirdepa ladaat et Hashem vego'". Umikkol maqom, en lo larutz ella ad petach bet hakkeneset, abal bebet hakkeneset atzmah yelek beema ubeyira. Vaapillu beshabbat sheasur lipsoa pesia gassa, vegam bechol notelet echad mit"q mimmeor enayv — ap al pi ken yarutz lekol debar mitzva. Abal kesheyyotze mibbet hakkeneset — asur larutz velo lipsoa pesia gassa, lepi shemmareh atzmo sheikkub bet hakkeneset domeh alayv lemasseoy. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheholek laasaqayv, abal im yotze al menat lachazor — mitzva larutz kede lachazor maher. Veken im yotze mibbet hakkeneset lebet hammidrash:

Muttar laroq bebet hakkeneset ap shehaya asur bammiqdash, ubilbad sheyyeshapshepennu beraglayv shello yihyeh megulleh bebet hakkeneset mippene hakkabod. Veim yesh teben o gemi bebet hakkeneset — roqeq alayv veen tzarik leshapshep, shehare hareqiqa mekussa begemi. Veim muttar laroq bitpillat y"ch — yitbaer besiman tz"z. Veharotzeh shello laroq tadir bebet hakkeneset — yilos qodem kenisato shoresh matoq (sheqqorin laqry"tz). Abal beereb yom kippur ubeereb t' beab — asur sheyyishshaer hammetiqut bepiv ukeshebbolea haroq bolea hammetiqut (abal mishshum beliat haroq lebaddo — en issur, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman (tqm"v) [tqs"z]):

Leolam yashkim adam lebet hakkeneset, kede sheyyizkeh veyimmaneh measara rishonim. Vehu sheyyitpallel sham immahem, sheapillu mea bain acharayv — notenim lo sakar keneged kullam. Vetob sheyyeasepu asara veyabou beyachad lebet hakkeneset:

Shenayim shennisharu lebaddam acharonim bebet hakkeneset umiher echad vesiyyem tepillato qodem chabero — chayyab ligmol chesed im chabero ulehamtin alayv, im hu bebet hakkeneset shebbassadot sheyyesh bahem chashash mazziqin, o apillu bebet hakkeneset shebbair ella shehi tepillat arbit shemmitpalelim ballayla, umepached chabero lehishshaer sham yechidi veal yede kak mitbalbelet tepillato. Veim chabero niknas yechidi beshaa shello yukal lesayyem immahem tepillato veap al pi ken amad lehitpallel — hare gilla dato sheeno mepached lishshaer yechidi, lepikak en tzarik lehamtin alayv min haddin. Abal middat chasidut lehamtin alayv apillu beinyan zeh, vaapillu bebet hakkeneset shebbair, vaapillu bitpillat shacharit umincha. Vekol zeh keshechabero maarik beseder hattepillot shedderek kol hatztzibbur leomram, abal im maarik bebaqqashot vetachanunim — en tzarik lehamtin alayv:

Haholek badderek vehiggia lemalon mibbeod yom verotzeh lalun sham, im yesh lepanayv ad d' milin vead biklal maqom shemmitpalelin baasara — tzarik lelek lalun sham, im yakol labo sham beod hayyom gadol [ve]shello yehe tzarik laleket yechidi, abal yoter mid' milin — lo hitrichuhu (chakamim). Uleacharayv — tzarik lachazor ad mil velo ad biklal kede lehitpallel baasara (vehu haddin haddar beyishshub tok mil lemaqom shemmitpalelin sham baasara — chayyab lelek bekol yom boqer veereb lehitpallel baasara). Umikkol shekken shello yashkim adam lelek lidbar hareshut meir shemmitpalelin sham baasara, im yakol labo limchoz cheptzo beod hayyom gadol veshello yehe tzarik laleket yechidi achar hattepilla (vaapillu im hu rotzeh lehashkim velelek qodem shehiggia zeman hattepilla), shettepillat hatztzibbur ap al pi shehu mitzva middibrehem hi gedola mimmitzvat aseh shel tora, hoil umeqaddeshin bah Hashem barabbim, shehare muttar laabor al mitzvat aseh shel tora uleshachrer abdo kede lehashlimo laasara, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea sy' (rm"z) [rs"z]. Umikkol maqom, talmud tora gadol mikkullam (shehare manu iyyun tepilla im harbeh debarim sheadam okel perotehem baolam hazzeh vehaqqeren qayyemet laolam habba veap al pi ken ameru "vetalmud tora keneged kullam"). Lepikak mi shettorato ummanuto veeno mitbattel kelal (ki im lidbarim hekrechiyyim letzorke gupo velimmudo) — en lo lebattel millimmudo velelek lebet hakkeneset ella yitpallel bebeto baasara, veim lo yimtza asara — tob lo sheyyitpallel yechidi mishsheyyitbattel millimmudo bishat halika lebet hakkeneset. Veap al pi ken lo yargil atzmo bekak, shello yilmedu amme haaretz mimmennu veyitbattelu mibbet hakkeneset, ki lo yadunu oto lekap zekut shebbishbil limmudo eno ba lebet hakkeneset. Umittaam zeh en lo laasoq battora bebet hakkeneset beshaa shehatztzibbur omerim selichot vetachanunim (o bishat qeriat hattora), ayyen siman qm"v. Abal im yakol leesop elayv asara lebeto — mitzva yoter sheyyitpallel bimqom midrasho haqqabua lo bebeto mishsheyyebattel limmudo veyelek lebet hakkeneset, ap al pi sheyyesh sham rob am shehu hadrat melek. Veen tzarik lomar bet hammidrash haqqabua larabbim sheqqedushshato gedola mibbet hakkeneset (kemo sheyyitbaer besiman (qtz"g) [qn"g]). Umitzva (ap lemi sheen torato ummanuto lehitpallel sham yoter mibbet hakkeneset apillu en bo rob am kemo bebet hakkeneset, vehu sheyyitpallel bo baasara):

Yiqba maqom litpillato shello yeshannehu, im lo letzorek gadol. Vekol mi sheqqobea maqom litpillato — elohe abraham beezro, shekken matzinu beabraham sheqqaba maqom litpillato, shenneemar: "vayyashkem abraham babboqer el hammaqom asher amad sham ku'". Veen day bemah sheyyiqba lo bet hakkeneset echad bair lehitpallel bo, ella gam bebet hakkeneset sheqqabua bo — tzarik sheyyehe lo maqom qabua. Vekol tok d' ammot chashub maqom echad, shei epshar letzamtzem. Vegam keshemmitpallel bebeto — yiqba lo maqom, shello yebalbeluhu bene habbayit:

Leolam yikkanes adam shiur b' petachim lebet hakkeneset veachar kak yitpallel, shenneemar: "lishmor mezuzot petachai". Yesh meporshim shiur b' petachim, dehaynu rochab ch' tepachim yikkanes lipnim, shello yesheb etzel happetach, lepi shennireh alayv kemassaoy ikkub bet hakkeneset veyihyeh mezumman samuk lappetach latzet. Ulepi zeh akshav shekkol echad makkir et meqomo, im yesh lo maqom meyuchad etzel happetach — en bekak kelum, shehaddabar yadua sheeno yosheb sham ella derek qebiut. Veyesh meporshim hattaam, mippene shemmabbit lachutz veeno yakol lekavven. Ulepi zeh im eno patuach lirshut harabbim — en bekak kelum. Veyesh meporshim shello yemaher lehitpallel miyyad kesheyyikkanes, ella yishheh kede hilluk shiur b' petachim, dehaynu ch' tepachim. Venakon lachosh lekol happerushim. Veyesh omerim shehammitpallel tzarik likkanes lipnim mib' delatot, shenneemar: "lishqod al daltotay vego'". Velaken nahagu laasot aksadra lipne bet hakkeneset:

Hammitpallel y"ch tzarik shello yihyeh dabar chotzetz beno leben haqqir, shenneemar: "vayyasseb chizqiyyahu panayv el haqqir vayyitpallel". Vedabar qabua kegon aron veteba — enam chotzetzin. Veken mittot shellanu haasuyim lishkiba veen derek letaltelan mimmaqom lemaqom — niqret dabar qabua veenan chotzetzot. Veeno chotzetz ella dabar gadol sheggobho y' tepachim verochbo d' tepachim al d' tepachim, abal dabar qatan eno chashub hepseq beno laqqir. Vekol dabar shehu tzorek hattepilla, apillu hu gadol harbeh — eno chashub hepseq, kegon hashshulchan shebbabbayit shemmannichin alayv hassiddur. Velaken nahagu bebet hakkeneset sheyyesh lipne kol echad shulchan qatan (sheqqorin shtandy"r) shemmannichin alayv hassiddurim ap al pi sheggaboah y' verachab d'. Vekol zeh lemitzva min hammubchar, abal im i epshar beqallut lehitpallel betzibbur beinyan shello yehe dabar sheggaboah y' verachab d' chotzetz beno leben haqqir, kegon lipamim shemmitpalelim baasara beezo cheder vei epshar lekol adam laamod belo chatzitza beno lakkotel — al yimmana mittepillat hatztzibbur bishbil zeh, ki en bazeh issur keshetztzarik lekak mitztzad dochaq hammaqom. Umikkol maqom yaatzim enayv o yitpallel mittok hassiddur velo yabbit lachutz, velo yabo lide bittul kavvana al yede dabar hachotzetz shellepanayv:

Baale chayyim chotzetzin. Veadam eno chotzetz, mippene shehu mino. Veyesh mi sheomer sheyyesh lizzaher millehitpallel achore shum adam. Vetob lachosh lidbarayv. Abal min haddin en issur ella baachore rabbo, kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman:

Begadim hamtzuyyarim shettolim bekotle bet hakkeneset lenoy, ap al pi shemmin haddin en bahem mishshum chatzitza — en nakon lehitpallel kenegdam, kede shello yehe mabbit betziyyuram velo yekavven bitpillato. Veim yiqreh lo lehitpallel negdam — yaatzim enayv. Vegam keshemmetzayyerim kotle bet hakkeneset — nakon shello letzayyer tziyyurim neged panayv shel adam, ella lemala miqqomat ish. Velaken en nakon gam ken letzayyer tziyyurim basseparim shemmitpalelin bahem, shello titbattel hakkavvana. Abal begadim shemmetzuyyar alehem dibre tiplut — apillu lesheb alehem bebet hakkeneset asur, vetzarik lehotziam mibbet hakkeneset, kede shello yishshaer lanu shum dabar bebet hakkeneset, ki mah lanu lehanniach bebet hakkeneset shellanu dabar shehu mukan umezumman letiplatam (abal shello bebet hakkeneset apillu metzuyyar alehen tzurot haasurim kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman qm"a — yesh lahen taqqana al yede bittul, kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman ql"t (veqam"h) [veqam"v]):

Lo yitpallel betzad rabbo velo achore rabbo ad sheyyarchiq d' ammot, mippene shekkesheomed battepilla mitztzad rabbo — mareh et atzmo keillu hem shavim, vaachore rabbo gam ken yuhara hu. Vekol shekken shello yitpallel lepanayv vaachorayv lerabbo, ella im ken hirchiq d' ammot. Veyesh omerim shekkol zeh keshemmitpalelin beyachid, abal bebet hakkeneset im kak hu seder yeshibato — en lachosh im mitpallel lepanayv o leacharayv. Veap al pi shettob lehachamir — hamminhag lehaqel. Veal kol panim tzarik lizzaher sheyyarchiq meachore rabbo kede sheyyukal rabbo lipsoa g' pesiot laachorayv, velo yitztarek lehamtin alayv ad sheyyesayyem hu et tepillato, venimtza gorem torach veikkub lerabbo. Veim hu talmid chaber — muttar. Abal lipne rabbo asur apillu betalmid chaber, ella al derek shennitbaer:
Kol maqom sheen qorin bo qeriat shema — en mitpalelin bo. Ukeshem shemmarchiqin mitztzoa ume raglayim vereach ra umin hammet umereiyyat haerva liqriat shema — kak marchiqin litpilla:

Haya omed bitpilla vehishtin tinoq bebet hakkeneset — yishtoq ad sheyyabiu mayim lehatil al hamme raglayim, o yehallek lepanayv ad sheyyihyu me raglayim leacharayv d' ammot, o yelek litzdadayv im i epshar lepanayv, o yetze mibbet hakkeneset veyigmor tepillato. Veyoter tob lelek lemaqom acher velo lishtoq, ki shemma yishheh kede ligmor et kullah veyitztarek lachazor larosh, venimtza gorem beraka sheenah tzerika:
